verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of API versioning or a deprecation policy. A date-stamped docs URL path (2025-12-08) hints at versioned docs, but no cited content describes how versions work or how deprecations are announced and timed. API versioning is a fair axis for an API-first identity platform, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
